title: Phase 5 - Notifications and workflow polish
description: Add workspace-scoped notifications, status badges, focus return, and workflow polish so parallel work stays manageable.

title: P5-001 Notification domain service
description: Create the workspace-scoped notification service and store instead of handling notifications ad hoc.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications can be created, marked read, and dismissed; each links to a workspace and optional job.

title: P5-002 Toast notification renderer
description: Render in-app toast notifications for relevant job completion and failure events.
acceptance_criteria: Toasts appear on relevant job events and clicking a toast can focus the workspace.

title: P5-003 Notification inbox / history pane
description: Add a durable notification history surface so toasts do not disappear into the void.
acceptance_criteria: Users can review older notifications and read/unread state works.

title: P5-004 Workspace status badge wiring
description: Wire real running, failure, and attention-needed state into workspace badges in sidebar and overview.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar and overview badges update live from real runtime state.

title: P5-005 Job completion focus action
description: Make job notifications actionable by restoring the relevant workspace and pane context.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a completion event restores the target workspace and focuses the relevant pane where possible.

title: Fix bun test runner split for Vitest, Playwright, and node:sqlite
description: The repo-level bun test gate currently fails for environment/config reasons unrelated to the new layout persistence work. Bun tries to execute the Playwright spec directly, and Bun does not provide node:sqlite for the main database tests. Clean up the test entrypoints so the default test command is trustworthy again.
acceptance_criteria: bun test runs the intended unit test suite without importing Playwright specs; SQLite-backed tests run in a supported runtime or are moved behind an explicit Node-only command; repo quality-gate docs/scripts reflect the intended commands.

title: Phase 0 - Spec freeze and spikes
description: Lock product boundaries, prove the Electron/Bun/Vite stack, and establish the initial domain and persistence foundations described in docs/03-roadmap-phases.md.

title: P0-001 Create decision log and scope file
description: Prevent drift before implementation starts by creating a durable decision log and scope file from the product docs.
acceptance_criteria: Product category, core panes, stack, preview limitation, and workspace/window rules are documented; non-goals are explicit.

title: P0-002 Electron shell spike
description: Prove the desktop shell can host the app cleanly by bootstrapping Electron with React, TypeScript, Bun, Vite, and Biome.
acceptance_criteria: App launches from one command; Bun/Vite dev workflow is acceptable; IPC round trip is proven; basic dev and build scripts exist.

title: P0-003 Monaco pane spike
description: Verify Monaco can be embedded cleanly in the chosen shell as the basis for light editor use.
acceptance_criteria: Syntax highlighting works; opening file text works; no obvious blocker for theme or resize handling.

title: P0-004 xterm.js + PTY spike
description: Prove a live terminal pane is viable early with xterm.js and a PTY backend.
acceptance_criteria: Shell launches on target OS; input/output works; resize works; process can be killed.

title: P0-005 Preview spike
description: Verify the preview pane can safely load local runtime surfaces without becoming a general browser.
acceptance_criteria: Localhost page renders; reload works; a basic isolation policy is decided.

title: P0-006 Persistence spike
description: Establish a basic SQLite-backed storage layer so project and workspace state does not need to be rewritten later.
acceptance_criteria: Projects and workspaces can be stored and reloaded; a migration strategy is chosen.

title: P0-007 CLI executable resolution spike
description: Create a utility layer to find, validate, and launch external binaries for provider adapters and other CLI integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Configured executable paths resolve; validation errors are human-readable; launching a test command works.

title: P0-008 Domain schema draft
description: Draft the initial shared TypeScript domain model for projects, workspaces, layouts, panes, jobs, and notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Project, Workspace, LayoutNode, Pane, Job, and Notification types exist; obvious gaps are listed.

title: Phase 1 - App skeleton and workspace domain
description: Build the durable app shell, project/workspace storage, selection state, and sidebar foundations so workspace becomes the top-level object.

title: P1-001 App shell scaffolding
description: Create the root application frame with the permanent sidebar rail area and main content region.
acceptance_criteria: App renders without mock-only hacks; layout scales with window resize.

title: P1-010 Workspace summary model
description: Create a compact derived summary model for workspace state so sidebar and overview surfaces stay lightweight.
acceptance_criteria: Summary includes branch, status, and placeholder job count without requiring deep data pulls.

title: P1-011 Navigation shell POC
description: Build a navigation-first proof of concept with demo projects, placeholder workspace panes, and a sidebar rail that proves spatial movement before real pane depth lands.
acceptance_criteria: Hardcoded or seeded demo projects/workspaces render by default for the POC; selecting projects and workspaces drives the full main region; placeholder pane surfaces make navigation targets visible; sidebar rail supports collapsed, hover-expand, and pinned-open states.

title: P1-012 HeroUI token and surface pilot
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Bring HeroUI v3 into the renderer in a controlled way by aligning shell tokens and proving a small surface-level integration without changing the navigation model or shell geometry.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 19, 20 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: HeroUI v3 coexists cleanly with the current shell stack; the shell theme exposes surface-friendly tokens; one contained pilot surface proves the visual direction; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P1-013 HeroUI shell primitive swap
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Replace the highest-value low-risk shell primitives with HeroUI v3 equivalents, focusing on buttons, badges or chips, tooltip styling, and keyboard hint treatments in the active shell.

User stories covered: 4, 5, 7, 19 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The project rail, top bar, and shell chrome use HeroUI-backed low-risk primitives where planned; the visual quality improves without changing navigation semantics; no visual regressions appear in the current shell; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P1-014 HeroUI forms for project and workspace creation
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Adopt HeroUI form primitives for project and workspace creation so setup flows feel cleaner, more intentional, and more accessible once the creation surfaces are real.

User stories covered: 8, 9, 17 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Project/workspace creation flows use HeroUI text field, input, select, label, description, and field error primitives where appropriate; validation and empty-state support remain clear; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P1-002 Project repository layer
description: Implement CRUD for project metadata so projects can group workspaces and load on app start.
acceptance_criteria: Create/read/update/delete project functions exist; project list loads on app start.

title: P1-003 Workspace repository layer
description: Implement CRUD for workspaces, including window ownership, so the workspace becomes the core persisted object.
acceptance_criteria: Create/read/update/delete workspace functions exist; workspaces link to projects; window ownership is stored.

title: P1-004 Workspace creation flow
description: Build the UI flow for creating a workspace from project, branch, and worktree configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create a workspace; branch name and worktree path are stored; failures are surfaced cleanly.

title: P1-005 App boot restore
description: Restore known projects and workspaces on app launch so relaunches preserve working context.
acceptance_criteria: Relaunch restores the sidebar structure; last-selected workspace behavior is intentionally handled.

title: P1-006 Workspace selection state
description: Create a shared store for current project, workspace, and pane selection.
acceptance_criteria: Selection changes propagate in UI and persist where appropriate.

title: P1-007 Main content placeholder workspace view
description: Render a placeholder workspace landing surface before the full pane system exists.
acceptance_criteria: The selected workspace renders in the main area; the empty state is clear.

title: P1-008 Sidebar rail foundation
description: Build the permanently visible sidebar and project rail foundation for the shell, keeping the rail narrow, non-overlapping, and navigation-first while the workspace owns the rest of the window.
acceptance_criteria: Rail is always visible; it never overlaps the main region; direct project selection works from the rail; holding Ctrl reveals numeric project hints; the top bar stays compact; the selected workspace and pane own the remaining window cleanly.

title: P1-009 Project/workspace tree in sidebar
description: Render the project/workspace tree so navigation is visible before keyboard polish.
acceptance_criteria: Projects group workspaces correctly; the current workspace is obvious; placeholder badges can render.

title: Phase 2 - Layout, navigation, sidebar, overview shell
description: Make the app spatial and usable with the split-tree layout, focus navigation, workspace switching, sidebar polish, and overview.

title: P2-001 Layout tree schema and persistence
description: Persist a split-tree layout model per workspace so pane arrangements survive reloads.
acceptance_criteria: Horizontal, vertical, and pane leaf nodes are supported; layouts restore after relaunch.

title: P2-010 Workspace state badges
description: Add badge slots and status states so sidebar and overview can display workspace health.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar and overview support placeholder job count, running state, and error state badges.

title: P2-011 Layout presets
description: Create common starter split layouts so users can jump into useful pane arrangements quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Applying a preset produces the intended split tree for the workspace.

title: P2-012 State repair for invalid layouts
description: Add normalization and fallback logic so malformed layout state does not brick workspace rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Bad or partial layout data falls back safely to a valid layout.

title: P2-013 HeroUI toolbar for pane indicator strip
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Rebuild the pane indicator strip with HeroUI toolbar-oriented primitives so pane navigation feels tighter, cleaner, and more intentional once pane focus behavior is stable.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 19 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The active pane indicator strip uses HeroUI toolbar-aligned components; pane focus state remains obvious; left/right pane movement semantics are unchanged; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-014 HeroUI workspace switcher overlay
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Rebuild the workspace switcher overlay with HeroUI list and overlay primitives so workspace movement feels premium, accessible, and easier to extend.

User stories covered: 10, 13, 16, 18 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace switcher overlay uses HeroUI listbox/popover-like primitives where appropriate; keyboard movement and active-state affordances remain strong; the overlay feels visually cleaner than the custom placeholder version; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-015 HeroUI scroll shadows and nested surfaces
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Add HeroUI scroll-shadow and surface concepts to the pane strip and nested pane internals so movement and depth are easier to perceive without changing pane ownership rules.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 19 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Horizontal pane movement gains clear scroll affordance; nested pane internals use a stronger surface hierarchy; the pane itself remains the full-region wrapper; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-016 HeroUI cleanup and shadcn reduction
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Remove obsolete shadcn wrappers and parallel styling layers after the selective HeroUI adoption tasks land, keeping only the custom shell structure plus the primitives that still pull their weight.

User stories covered: 4, 19, 20 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Unused shadcn wrappers and redundant dependencies are removed where safe; the shell keeps its custom navigation architecture; the resulting UI stack is simpler and more coherent; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-017 Spatial navigation state model
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Replace the current selection-driven shell state with a resolved project->workspace->pane navigation model that supports deterministic boot restore, repair rules, and direction-aware transitions without snap-back to index 0.

User stories covered: 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 13, 14 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The shell resolves a full navigation path once at boot; project/workspace/pane state updates through one navigation model; invalid remembered state repairs deterministically; no reset-to-first-pane or reset-to-first-workspace occurs during normal movement; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-018 Horizontal pane camera track
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Make pane movement a true horizontal camera over the active workspace so exactly one pane is visible at a time, every pane is reachable, and click plus keyboard movement stay in sync.

User stories covered: 1, 5, 14, 15 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Only one pane is visible at a time; clicking any pane indicator reaches the correct pane; `Alt+Left/Right` and `Alt+h/l` move reliably; pane movement direction is visually correct; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-019 Vertical workspace camera track
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Render workspace movement as a vertical camera inside the active project so switching workspaces feels like moving up and down instead of replacing content in place.

User stories covered: 2, 4, 6, 10, 14 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace movement is visibly vertical; `Alt+Up/Down` and `Alt+j/k` work in the desktop app; workspace switcher overlay and sidebar selection target the same state model; switching workspaces updates the main region and rail together; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-002 Layout renderer
description: Render nested split trees recursively so workspace layout becomes visible.
acceptance_criteria: Nested layouts render correctly and resize stably.

title: P2-020 Project context restore chain
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Persist and restore each project's last active workspace and pane so project switches preserve spatial context instead of resetting to defaults.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 10, 11 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Project switching restores the remembered workspace and pane for that project; `Ctrl+digit` and project-rail clicks use the same restore path; switching projects never resets to workspace 0 or pane 0 unless no valid remembered target exists; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-021 Terminal session reattachment for spatial shell
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Make terminal sessions workspace/pane-owned runtime services that survive leaving a pane or workspace and reattach when the user returns.

User stories covered: 7, 8, 9 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Leaving the terminal pane does not kill the PTY; leaving and returning to the workspace reattaches the session; terminal navigation shortcuts do not get swallowed; explicit close remains the only destructive action; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-022 Electron Playwright navigation verification
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Add Electron-aware Playwright coverage for pane, workspace, and project movement so desktop regressions are caught where the browser path is insufficient.

User stories covered: 5, 6, 10, 12, 14 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright covers pane 4/5 reachability, workspace switching from terminal focus, project jump restore, and no snap-back on boot or context switch in Electron; failures are actionable and artifacts are retained; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and the relevant Playwright command pass.

title: P2-023 Sidebar tree interaction polish
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Polish the new project/workspace tree so expand-collapse behavior, active-project synchronization, and keyboard accessibility feel deliberate instead of provisional.

User stories covered: 5, 7, 10, 11 from docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md.
acceptance_criteria: The active project stays expanded; tree toggles expose clear expanded state; keyboard interaction remains usable; the tree feels stable and intentional while preserving the current navigation model; bun test, bun run build, bunx @biomejs/biome check ., and npx -y react-doctor@latest . pass.

title: P2-003 Pane placeholder system
description: Introduce pane placeholders with type badges and focus state before real pane implementations exist.
acceptance_criteria: Placeholders can represent any pane type; focus ring and selection styling exist.

title: P2-004 Split/close/resize operations
description: Implement the layout commands users need to shape a workspace: split, close, and resize.
acceptance_criteria: Panes can be split and closed without corrupting layout; last-pane protection is defined.

title: P2-005 Pane focus navigation
description: Implement pane neighbor focus rules to make left/right pane movement a real product promise.
acceptance_criteria: Alt+Left and Alt+Right work; focus state is never ambiguous; vertical behavior is defined or intentionally absent.

title: P2-006 Workspace switching shortcuts
description: Add fast keyboard switching between workspaces in the current project.
acceptance_criteria: Users can cycle workspaces; main content and sidebar update together.

title: P2-007 Ctrl-hold project jump hints
description: Implement the Ctrl-hold numeric hint overlay for direct project switching from the sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: Holding Ctrl reveals project numbers; pressing a number jumps project; releasing Ctrl hides hints.

title: P2-008 Sidebar interaction polish
description: Polish keyboard focus, hover intent, pin behavior, and selection handling for the sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: Hover does not flicker badly; keyboard access is usable; pinned-open state persists.

title: P2-009 Overview shell
description: Create the initial overview switcher for fast project and workspace jumps.
acceptance_criteria: Overview opens with a shortcut; users can jump to a workspace; current selection is obvious.

title: Phase 6 - Multi-window and usability pass
description: Add detached workspace windows, ownership rules, global notification routing, and onboarding without breaking the workspace model.

title: Phase 3 - Core panes
description: Implement the first real workspace tool surfaces: terminal, git, preview, editor, jobs, logs, and real presets.

title: P3-001 Pane registry
description: Create a central pane type registry and factory so real panes plug into one composition system.
acceptance_criteria: Pane types resolve to renderers and default metadata/state can be created centrally.

title: P3-010 Editor pane renderer
description: Render Monaco as a real editor pane for inspection, light editing, and saving.
acceptance_criteria: Files open, save, and track dirty state.

title: P3-011 Jobs domain model and service
description: Create the workspace-scoped jobs store and service that future provider and notification flows depend on.
acceptance_criteria: Jobs can be created, updated, completed, and failed; job lists are queryable by workspace.

title: P3-012 Jobs pane
description: Render the jobs pane so running and recent background work is visible in the workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Running and completed jobs are visible and status is visually obvious.

title: P3-002 Terminal session manager
description: Implement workspace-scoped terminal sessions that survive naive renderer lifecycle changes.
acceptance_criteria: Sessions can be created per workspace, reattached by pane, and tracked through process lifecycle.

title: P3-003 Terminal pane renderer
description: Render xterm.js as a real terminal pane with attach/detach and resize handling.
acceptance_criteria: Users can type commands; output streams live; resize does not break the terminal.

title: P3-004 Git service layer
description: Create a workspace-scoped git wrapper service for branch state, file status, and parseable errors.
acceptance_criteria: Branch name, changed files, and staged/unstaged state are available; parseable errors are emitted.

title: P3-005 Git pane renderer
description: Render the git pane as the review and trust surface for changed files.
acceptance_criteria: Changed files are visible; staged/unstaged state is obvious; selecting a file updates the review surface.

title: P3-006 Diff viewer
description: Add a diff surface so the git pane can show meaningful file review context.
acceptance_criteria: File diffs render and large diffs do not freeze obviously.

title: P3-007 Preview target model
description: Define workspace-scoped preview targets and active target selection.
acceptance_criteria: A workspace can store one or more preview targets and mark one active.

title: P3-008 Preview pane renderer
description: Render the preview pane for local runtime URLs with reload support.
acceptance_criteria: Local runtime loads; reload works; users can change the active target.

title: P3-009 Editor file open path
description: Create a file resolver and open-file action so git and chat can jump into files.
acceptance_criteria: File paths open into an editor pane and missing-file errors are handled cleanly.

title: Phase 4 - Chat and provider adapter layer
description: Turn the shell into an AI-native product with chat, provider adapters, normalized events, and a job-backed execution pipeline.

title: P4-001 Provider adapter interface
description: Define the shared app-facing provider contract, event model, and capability model before real integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Interface, normalized event types, and capability flags exist in code.

title: P4-010 Provider capability flags
description: Expose explicit capability flags so the UI can adapt to provider differences without hard-coded branches.
acceptance_criteria: UI can react to streaming, approvals, and file-event richness via shared capability flags.

title: P4-013 Workspace default provider selection
description: Allow each workspace to set a preferred default provider.
acceptance_criteria: Prompts use the configured default provider unless the user overrides it.

title: P4-014 Approval/attention request UX hook
description: Add a generic attention-needed state so provider tasks can pause for human confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Jobs can enter an attention-needed state and the UI makes it distinct from running or completed.

title: P4-002 Provider executable configuration UI
description: Let users configure and validate local provider executable paths.
acceptance_criteria: Users can set provider binaries and receive clear validation errors.

title: P4-003 Chat thread domain model
description: Create a workspace-scoped thread, message, and task model independent of any provider implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Chat thread state persists per workspace and can store messages plus task links.

title: P4-004 Chat pane renderer
description: Render the workspace chat pane with transcript, input, and linked job state.
acceptance_criteria: Users can send prompts; transcript renders; pending state is visible.

title: P4-005 Claude Code adapter
description: Implement the first real provider adapter using Claude Code for launch, streaming, and completion lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks start successfully; stream events normalize; completion and failure map into jobs.

title: P4-006 Chat-to-job pipeline
description: Connect chat prompts to job creation and provider execution so the shell owns the full task lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Sending a prompt creates a job; status updates during the run; completed jobs link back to the thread.

title: P4-007 Provider command event surfacing
description: Expose provider command planning and execution events in chat, jobs, and logs surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Commands appear with timestamps and state; command history is inspectable for a task.

title: P4-008 File-change surfacing from provider events
description: Connect provider file-change events into the git and editor review flow.
acceptance_criteria: Provider-touched files are identifiable and users can jump from chat/job to file or diff review.

title: P4-009 Cancellation and failure handling
description: Handle cancellation, failure states, and retries so bad runs can be stopped and understood.
acceptance_criteria: Cancel ends a job or reports inability clearly; failed jobs are visible and inspectable.
